Visual Focus The core visual centers on a cartoon green crocodile DJ, rendered with a green background and pink line-art graffiti texture. The main scene depicts two crocodiles operating a DJ deck, accented with musical notes to emphasize the relaxed and witty atmosphere of the party. 2. Information Elements The details are organized with a clear hierarchy: the title "TALIEU & FRIENDS" stands out in bold white text. It also lists the date "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025 1PM-10PM", the lineup (Archie Briant), and the venue "93 FEET EAST 150 BRICK LANE, LONDON, E1 6QL". 3. Color & Texture Dominated by a green base, pink graffiti outlines, and white typography, the design overlays cartoon figures and DJ elements to recreate the retro, playful texture of 90s underground EDM party posters. Style: retro cartoon graffiti poster. The image is a single event-poster design with a dark green, grainy, distressed background, hot-pink spray-paint outlines, white block typography, and black ink-style cartoon crocodiles. Across the upper portion, oversized white brush lettering reads "TALIEU", with rough dry-brush edges and a hand-painted street-art feel. Beneath it, a large hot-pink ampersand reads "&", followed by another large white brush-lettered word, "FRIENDS", completing the title "TALIEU & FRIENDS". Pink paint splatters, drips, and underline strokes surround the headline, while small pink musical-note icons float around the composition. On the left side below the title, the date and time appear in stacked white uppercase text as "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025" and "1PM-10PM". Below that, a smaller white label reads "LINEUP:", followed by the performer name "ARCHIE BRIANT" in larger white uppercase letters. Near the lower-left area, the venue information appears in bold white uppercase text as "93 FEET EAST" and "150 BRICK LANE, LONDON, E1 6QL". In the central-right foreground, two anthropomorphic crocodile DJs occupy the main illustration. The larger crocodile sits behind a DJ setup, wearing oversized black headphones with green accents and a dark jacket or hoodie. Its green scaly skin has darker spots, black outlines, expressive eyes, and a slightly open mouth showing small teeth. One hand rests near the turntable while the other reaches toward the mixer controls. The second crocodile appears to the right, also wearing headphones and leaning over the equipment with an excited, open-mouthed expression. The DJ deck includes turntables, tonearms, knobs, sliders, cables, and small glowing pink indicator lights, all drawn in a gritty comic-graffiti style. Behind the characters, a neon-pink outline drawing of a boombox spans the mid-right background, with cassette details, speakers, buttons, and dripping paint effects. Additional pink graffiti marks, curved strokes, splashes, and music symbols fill the surrounding space, reinforcing the underground EDM party atmosphere. The overall palette is dominated by deep green, hot pink, white, and black, with high contrast, rough textures, and a playful 1990s underground poster aesthetic.
